A '''pirate raid''' was carried out on a [[Unidentified passenger liner|passenger liner]], which was commanded by a [[Unidentified passenger liner's captain|captain]]. The [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'' happened across the event, and saved the liner from the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], though the pirates were offered jobs aboard the frigate.
